_README: Recorded SMALL synthetic infrared.city UTCI response (record/replay fixture for the offline Climate Layer suite). merged_grid is an 8x8 grid of degrees Celsius. GRID CONVENTION (RESEARCH Pitfall 1, skill grid-conventions.md): row 0 = SOUTH edge, col 0 = WEST edge (plot with origin='lower'). null = NaN = OUTSIDE the site polygon (the SDK returns 512x512 with data in one corner; here the outer 1-cell ring is masked). The interior cell at [row 3][col 3] = 24.5 is a known <26 C cell preserved into the artifact (CLIMATE-02 is a SCORE-time filter, NOT a write-time drop — RESEARCH Pitfall 2). Remaining interior cells span ~26..34 C. bounds is the true NE-padded WGS84 grid extent (result.bounds, SDK 0.4.4+), a tiny real box near the Parc del Forum centroid so projection through src/crs yields sane EPSG:32631 metres.
